title: Material Exchange Format - Mapping AVC Streams into the MXF Generic Container
scope: This document specifies the mapping of all AVC coding data as defined in ISO/IEC 14496-10 | ITU-T Rec. H.264 into the Material Exchange Format Generic Container (MXF-GC) based on the MXF MPEG mapping standard (SMPTE 381M) The MXF specification is written in several parts. This is one of a set of documents that define the contents of the MXF File Body. In order to achieve interoperability within any given Operational Pattern, restrictions may be placed on the way in which this Generic Container type can be implemented. The reader is advised to carefully study the appropriate Operational Pattern document before implementation.
